audience.text: Developers building .NET 8+ applications who need spreadsheet manipulation without requiring Microsoft Excel or native Office installations.

capabilities.text: Create, load, and modify Excel workbooks using Workbook, Worksheet, Cells, and Cell APIs.
capabilities.title: Workbook and cell manipulation

capabilities.text: Apply fonts, fills, borders, alignment, and locking via Style, Font, Border, and Borders APIs.
capabilities.title: Formatting and styling

capabilities.text: Configure data validation rules and conditional formatting using Validation, ValidationCollection, and ConditionalFormattingCollection.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Export workbook content to PDF using SaveFormat.Pdf or PdfSaveOptions.
capabilities.title: PDF export

capabilities.text: Create and manipulate charts, pictures, and shapes via ChartCollection, PictureCollection, and ShapeCollection.
capabilities.title: Charts and shapes

capabilities.text: Apply auto-filters and list objects using AutoFilter, FilterColumnCollection, and ListObject APIs.
capabilities.title: Filtering and tables

capabilities.text: Read and write built-in and extended document properties via DocumentProperties and ExtendedDocumentProperties.
capabilities.title: Document properties

limitations.text: Only .xlsx format is supported for loading and saving workbooks.
The library stores formulas but does not include a formula calculation engine.
No general HTML export or image export API is provided.
Macros, VBA, and pivot tables are outside the supported public API surface.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook creation, editing, and PDF export in .NET without requiring Microsoft Excel.
Supports loading malformed Excel files with diagnostic reporting via LoadOptions and LoadDiagnostics.
Provides a consistent API surface for cell, style, and formatting operations across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET is an MIT-licensed .NET 8+ library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks and exporting them to PDF.

workflows.name: Create and save workbook
workflows.text: Instantiate a Workbook, manipulate Cells and Worksheet objects, then save using SaveFormat.Xlsx or SaveFormat.Pdf.

workflows.name: Load and repair workbook
workflows.text: Use LoadOptions to load a workbook, then inspect LoadDiagnostics to identify and report issues.

workflows.name: Apply formatting and validation
workflows.text: Set Cell values, apply Style with Font, Border, and alignment, and configure Validation or ConditionalFormattingCollection.

workflows.name: Export to PDF
workflows.text: Call Workbook.Save with SaveFormat.Pdf or pass PdfSaveOptions to render the workbook to PDF.
